title: Proximity-verification policy
description: The proximity-detection bands accepted for verifying a physical hand-off on this order, committed at agreement signing. Each band corresponds to a standard short-range detection technology — Wi-Fi presence, Bluetooth Low Energy, ultra-wideband ranging, or NFC contact. Multi-valued: the designer commits the set the assembly accepts; an order carrying no proximity-policy clause requires no proximity verification. The runtime proof that a hand-off actually occurred within an accepted band is filed as a runtime attestation at stage 1 — by either party (a counterparty may be absent, e.g. a dead drop: the attester carries the device/network identifier as evidence in lieu of the counterparty). Sufficiency of witnessing is derived at read time against the committed bands, never enforced by the protocol.

fields.name: bands
fields.label: Detection bands
fields.description: The proximity-detection technologies the assembly accepts, ordered loosest to closest. zone-wifi = same Wi-Fi network (presence within an access point's coverage). nearby-ble = Bluetooth Low Energy proximity (~metres). precise-uwb = ultra-wideband ranging (IEEE 802.15.4z / FiRa; decimetre-accurate distance at range). contact-nfc = NFC tap (near-contact, ~centimetres). At least one must be set when this clause is present.

1.name: band
1.label: Detected band
1.description: The band the hand-off was witnessed within. Must be one of the committed bands — checked at read time, like every content/policy comparison.

1.name: evidenceUri
1.label: Witness evidence
1.description: Optional reference to the detection artifact at mechanism grain — a device-captured evidence document (geohash cell, keccak-hashed tag/device identifiers, raw-capture hash) or a counterparty co-signature. Raw identifiers (Wi-Fi BSSIDs, BLE beacon ids, NFC tap payloads) and coordinates stay device-held for dispute-time revelation, bound by the raw-capture hash — never pinned publicly.
